content.title: Every EGOT winner, from Audrey Hepburn to Steven Spielberg
content.text: Business Insider All 22 people who have won an EGOT, the most coveted award in Hollywood Viola Davis became an EGOT in 2023. Jeffrey Mayer/WireImage/Getty Images Updated Mar 17, 2026, 1:54 PM UTC Very few celebrities in Hollywood can brag about being an EGOT winner.Achieving an Emmy, a Grammy, an Oscar, and a Tony (EGOT) is a feat so difficult that only 22 stars have earned it. Among them are Rita Moreno, Whoopi Goldberg, Audrey Hepburn, Elton John, John Legend, and, most recently, Steven Spielberg. There's also one person, Robert Lopez, who is a double EGOT winner and the youngest celebrity ever to win all four awards.Here's the full list of every EGOT winner (excluding those who achieved the acronym with honorary or noncompetitive awards).Palmer Haasch and Olivia Singh contributed to an earlier version of this story.
